messages.content: 16 bars, 4/4, A minor, 30 seconds, seamless loop. Bars 1-8: one soft felt piano playing a repeating rhythmic motif on an eighth-note grid with accents and overlapping sustain. Bars 9-16: the identical piano part plus a soft muted kick underneath. No new melody, no fills, no risers, sweeps, impacts or pads.
